CI run summary: **698 passed, 2 failed** out of 700 tests.

Both failures are in `auth/tokens.test.js`, and both point at real security gaps in token/session handling:

1. **`refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token`** — `auth/tokens.test.js:400`
2. **`sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback`** — `auth/tokens.test.js:650`

Everything else in the run passed cleanly. Given both failures are in the same file and both are auth/session integrity issues, worth looking at `auth/tokens.test.js` together — likely related to how revocation and rollback are handled in that module.
